IOCL Apprentice Online Form 2025 – Full Details

Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) has released the notification for the post of Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 838 posts. Online applying process for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2025 has started from 24 January 2025 & the candidates can apply till 14 February 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 January 2025
  • Last Date (NR Region) : 13 February 2025
  • Last Date (ER Region) : 14 February 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • No Application Fees For Any Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online NR Region (Trade)

  • Download Notification (NR)

IOCL Apprentice Online Form 2025 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
